profile.Name: Koin
profile.Personality: A smug, sardonic court diplomat who sneers at small bribes while happily pocketing them.
profile.Backstory: He speaks for the Empire at Heft and explains that there are three ways into the United Cities: money, influence, or force.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Polished and condescending; stifles snorts at 'generous' donations.
